kpis.description_fr: HDD = pure-play post-spin SanDisk. Reprise massive 2024 via demand cloud archive + AI training data lakes. Cycle bottoming dépassé.
kpis.description_en: HDD = pure-play post SanDisk spin. Massive 2024 recovery via cloud archive + AI training data lake demand. Cycle bottoming passed.

kpis.description_fr: Cloud (hyperscalers) ~55 % du CA HDD. Mix premium high-capacity nearline drives 30+ TB. Tailwind IA data archives.
kpis.description_en: Cloud (hyperscalers) ~55% of HDD revenue. Premium high-capacity nearline drives 30+ TB mix. AI data archive tailwind.

kpis.description_fr: Technologies UltraSMR + future HAMR (Heat-Assisted Magnetic Recording) drives 40+ TB. Démarrage 2026-27. Tailwind exabyte demand IA.
kpis.description_en: UltraSMR + future HAMR (Heat-Assisted Magnetic Recording) technologies drive 40+ TB. Launch 2026-27. Exabyte AI demand tailwind.

kpis.description_fr: Capacité moyenne par HDD vendu ~13 TB. Mix shift continu vers high-capacity drives (20-30 TB). ASP rising = pricing power.
kpis.description_en: Avg capacity per HDD sold ~13 TB. Continuous mix shift to high-capacity drives (20-30 TB). Rising ASP = pricing power.

kpis.description_fr: 420 EB shipped 2024. Croissance forte structurelle data center storage. KPI volume capacité.
kpis.description_en: 420 EB shipped 2024. Strong structural data center storage growth. Capacity volume KPI.

notes: Western Digital fiscal year se termine fin juin (FY25 = juillet 2024-juin 2025). Spin-off SanDisk (NAND business) effectif février 2025 — WDC standalone = HDD only post-spin.
